title: Friend abducted by grays, shows delta-pattern marks

tellings.quote: he said, "I forgot to tell you. They came and got me."

plain: A friend staying at Tim Alberino's house told him one day, "I forgot to tell you. They came and got me," meaning he had been taken by grays, the small grey-skinned beings of many abduction stories, and he showed marks on his body laid out in a triangle pattern. Alberino, a guest who also talks about a giant captured in Afghanistan, tells it as something he witnessed when his friend showed him the marks.
